assumptions: Batch size 1 (one stream per agent); vectorized rows are a later comparison against this behavior.

Source ports project one-way at fan-scaled magnitude source_scale; loop-forming reciprocal projections at scale. The foundation's uniform 0.2 left the prediction neurons silent (input difference 3e-5 at Y).
The perceptual relay is omitted for symbolic input (perceptual=0); dynamics also reads the sensory copy directly, so predictions are two hops from sensors and one from the action copy.
Readout pairs (dynamics-prediction, workspace-motor) start at zero: uniform predictions and a uniform policy; their contrasts are nonzero from the first nudge.
Missingness flags are driven when a value is unobserved, so constant flags do not dominate the sensory code.

Every phase is a checked settle (equilibrate) to residual 1e-6 within the step budget; updates whose phases miss it, or whose nudged phases sit in different attractors (gap above max_phase_gap), are rejected and counted.
Each synapse's step is divided by its postsynaptic plastic fan-in; per-update steps are clipped.
Actor temperature 0.2 rather than the foundation's 1: at temperature 1 the sampled policy cannot exceed 0.75 on two actions with activations in (-0.1, 1).
